name: N-gram频率分析
description: Analyzes word and character n-gram distributions to detect patterns characteristic of AI-generated text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through statistical analysis of word sequence patterns
mechanism: Extracts character-level and word-level n-gram frequency distributions and compares them against known distributions for human and AI-generated text. AI text generators produce characteristic n-gram patterns — often over-representing common phrases and under-representing rare but natural human constructions.
source: Lavergne et al. (2008) - Detecting Fake Content with Relative Entropy Scoring, PAN-SEPLN
algorithm: N-gram Extraction + Frequency Distribution Analysis + KL-Divergence Scoring
parameters: N-gram sizes: 2-5, Level: character + word, Comparison: KL-divergence, chi-square, Corpus: reference distributions
strengths:
• Language-model agnostic approach
• Can analyze very short texts
• Computationally efficient
• Captures subtle distribution differences
limitations:
• Requires reference distributions for calibration
• Domain-specific text may skew results
• Modern AI models converge toward natural distributions
• Cross-domain generalization can be weak

references.title: Lavergne, T. et al. (2008). Detecting Fake Content with Relative Entropy Scoring. PAN-SEPLN.
